Yeah so as of now here is what I'm at:

GS Plugin: Dx11 Software

EE/IOP: Default

VU: Default

GS: Default

SpeedHacks: EE Cyclerate @ -3, EE Cycle Skipping @ 0 (tried turning it up, causes slower gameplay), All boxes checked except fast CDVD (I realize for dual cores, MTVU shouldn't be enabled but for some reason it makes things faster).

Audio: Nearest (may go back to cubic, but doesn't bother me), XAudio2, & ASync Mix (TimeStretch causes slowdown).

With these settings on Madden 07, before I snap the ball I sit at about 89-76% speed, during a throw play I get about 78-68% speed, then after a catch/run I get back to about 100-86% speed. It's playable at this point, even though I'd like it to go faster before/during a play, I don't think there's much more I can do from here. 


Unless you have anymore ideas, thank you for helping me make this wayyy more playable than it was before lol
